AboutPage.header:
Spark Test:
Reliable inspection of waterproofing membranes
AboutPage.paragraph1: What is a spark test and why use it? The spark test is a proven and precise method of checking the impermeability of waterproofing layers, most often PVC, TPO, FPO or bitumen sheets. Using a detection device with a high-voltage discharge, it can detect even the smallest defects – microcracks, punctures or leaks that would otherwise remain hidden beneath the surface.
AboutPage.paragraph2: How does the spark test work? The principle is simple: the membrane is underlaid with an electrically conductive material (e.g. geotextile or a damp substrate) and then an electrode connected to a high-voltage source is passed over the surface. If there is a hole or crack in the insulation, the electric discharge jumps through it – which is immediately recorded. This process is fast, precise and reliable.
AboutPage.when-header: When is a spark test recommended?
when-list: After a new installation of a roofing membrane
After repairs or interventions in the insulation
Before handover of the building (to verify contractor quality)
When there is suspicion of leakage
benefits-list: Non-invasive method – does not damage the membrane
Increases certainty and reduces the risk of later damage
Suitable for flat and pitched roofs with membrane waterproofing
AboutPage.for-header: Who is the spark test for
for-list: Building managers – to prevent leaks and reduce repair costs
Construction companies and developers – for quality control and verifiable results
Homeowners – when in doubt about roof reliability

AkoFunguje.paragraph1: The spark test is a reliable way to accurately detect defects and leaks in the waterproofing of flat roofs. The test is quick, does not damage the roof, and you get results immediately. A report of the performed test is also included.
checklist: Without unnecessary interventions or dismantling of the roof

PrecoIskrovka.text: During the inspection of a residential building roof in Bratislava, we detected several leaks in the waterproofing. Water seeped through details at the parapet and caused damage in two apartments. Thanks to the spark test, we precisely identified the water entry points, so the repair was quick and limited only to necessary areas. The whole process took one day and saved the owner thousands of euros that would otherwise have to be invested in extensive reconstruction.

Referencie.intro: We have helped dozens of clients accurately determine the condition of roof insulation. Here are their experiences:

review1.text: During the roof inspection, we found leaks near the parapet through which water was seeping into two apartments. The test accurately showed the defect locations and the repair was completed in just one day. The owner thus saved on extensive reconstruction.

review2.text: On an area of more than 2,000 m², we detected three leaks in the insulation by testing. Thanks to precise localization, only what was truly necessary was repaired, without interrupting operation.

review3.text: The client suspected leakage but could not identify the source. The spark test confirmed damage to the insulation at the HVAC penetrations. The repair was quick and prevented further interior damage.
